paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is currently 2.35, with a decrease of 9.96% from the prior close and 41.69% over the last 22 sessions. There have been 2 new news items in the last 24 hours.

Recent news includes a report from Investing.com UK that the stock hit a 52-week low at 2.44 USD, and an article from Yahoo Finance stating that Fermi is advancing Project Matador and pivoting to a powered-land strategy after a director vote failed.

There have been various filings, including 4 Form 4 and 3 Form 144 filings, with recent filings including insider transaction reports and a notice of proposed sale of restricted shares, as well as an 8-K filing announcing an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd.
